pages.name: Old Indian: 5.g3 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted a b8-knight that is already on d7 via f8, where the bishop stands; plan 4 played Re1 before castling. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Indian: 5.g3 Be7, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted the b8-knight via d7-f8-g6 (it is already on d7 and f8 holds the rook). Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Indian: 5.e4
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f4-f5 through the f3-knight; the overview promised a kingside attack. Rewrote overview and plan 1 (reviewer rejection of the carried-over overview fixed and re-reviewed); British spelling.

pages.name: Old Indian: 5.e4 Be7 6.g3
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted a b8-knight that is already on d7 via ...a6-b8-c6. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Indian: 5.e4 c6
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Re1 before castling; plan 2 wrote castling as 0-0; overview called the structure hedgehog-like. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: Old Indian: Main Line, 8.Be3

pages.name: Old Indian: Main Line, 8.Qc2

pages.name: Old Indian: Main Line, 8.Qc2 Re8

pages.name: Old Indian: Main Line, 8.Re1 a6 9.Bf1

pages.notes: Plan 1 routed ...Ne8-d6 and left out the main ...f5 break; plan 4 wrote castling as 0-0 and Be2 without e4; plan 2 promised a d6 weakness. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling.
